# {Feature name}

## Overview

Describe the customer-visible capability and expected outcome, supported by VI and product evidence.

## Configuration

List each supported setting and how to configure it. Cite evidence in the Doc Contract, not in customer prose.

## Defaults

State defaults only when the checked-in product configuration/code supports them.

## Limitations

List verified platform and scope limitations. If unknown, report the gap instead of guessing.

## Troubleshooting

Include only evidence-backed troubleshooting guidance. If none is available, state that troubleshooting information is not established and report the gap.
